source: ORCHESTRAL.md 21, practical instrument ranges: approximate sounding ranges for MIDI composition, not absolute limits; always check the specific library, and treat extremes as special colours rather than default writing areas.
convention_note: ORCHESTRAL.md does not state its octave names. Its ranges are the standard sounding ranges in scientific pitch (C4 = 60): the violin's open G3 is MIDI 55. Live's piano roll calls MIDI 55 G2, so reading these names in Live's convention would put every part an octave too high.
extensions_note: Some double-bass libraries extend to C1; do not use extension notes unless the instrument actually has them.

layer_budget.note: At most moments. If the music becomes muddy, reduce competing musical functions before reaching for EQ.
